newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures end sharply up on weaker yen.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures end sharply up on weaker yen.

text.p: All Tokyo rubber futures ended sharply higher on Friday, as the yen's steep falls in the afternoon triggered active buying, traders said.
Prices were 0.4 to 5.2 yen higher, with benchmark July up 1.3 yen at 157.3 yen per kg.

The yen-based rubber market was weaker in early trading, due to technical selling from individual investors, traders said. "The yen's falls turned sentiment bullish by late afternoon," a brokerage house trader said.
The dollar powered its way above the 124 yen level, rising to 124.30 yen, a fresh four-year high, in Tokyo on Friday.
